hook_chosen_reason: Provocative observation highlighting misallocated creative energy in B2B content.
caption:
Most creators spend 80% of their time on logistics and 20% on creative thought.

They record for 45 minutes.
Then spend 3 hours:
- Scrubbing video timelines
- Fixing auto-transcription errors
- Resizing to 9:16 vertical
- Copy-pasting captions into 4 different scheduling tabs

This is why podcasters burn out.

The future belongs to creators who run their content like a software pipeline: record once, let AI text-edit and repurpose, and publish from one central screen.

Work on the message. Let software handle the distribution.

#CreatorOps #ContentStrategy #B2BMarketing #Productivity #IncuBrix
